items.original_title: Shutdown Risks Emerge as Democrats Consider Ways to End Iran War
items.rss_summary:
Congressional Democrats are weighing whether to use a Dec. 11 government shutdown deadline to try to pressure President Donald Trump to end the war in Iran. 
The approach to the looming funding cliff is the most important decision facing Democrats as the current Republican-controlled Congress begins its lame duck session this week. 
Henrietta Treyz, Director of Economic Policy at Veda Partners, examines the post-midterm impact for President Trump's policy agenda. (Source: Bloomberg)
